[EN] While chasing Mihog, you learned the demokrons actually were Parthians, transformed via cruel experiments. Enraged, the Khirian commander Rhodos swore revenge.
[ES] Mientras perseguías a Mihog, te enteraste de que los demokrons en realidad eran Parthians, transformados a través de crueles experimentos. Enfurecido, el comandante khirian Rhodos juró venganza.

[EN] (This barrel is too neat compared to the dusty barrels around. And someone seems to have moved it recently.)Move the barrel
[ES] (Este barril está demasiado ordenado en comparación con los barriles polvorientos de alrededor. Y parece que alguien lo ha movido recientemente.)Move the barrel

[EN] Archdevan sorcerer? She ran right past me, with Zolyn and the popori right behind her!"Okay, thanks."
[ES] ¿Hechicera archdeva? ¡Pasó corriendo junto a mí, con Zolyn y el popori justo detrás de ella!"Okay, thanks."

[EN] Zolyn went after her. If you hurry, you can catch up to her and kill that damned archdeva!"What about Rhodos?"
[ES] Zolyn fue tras ella. Si te apresuras, ¡puedes alcanzarla y matar a esa maldita archdeva!"What about Rhodos?"

[EN] I'll talk to Rhodos...calm him down. You worry about the archdevan sorcerer!"Consider it done!"
[ES] Hablaré con Rhodos... lo calmaré. ¡Tú preocúpate por la hechicera archdeva!"Consider it done!"

[EN] This overcautious buffoon suspected a trap and wouldn't let me get by! Now we've lost the archdevan sorcerer's trail."Don't blame him too much."
[ES] ¡Este bufón hiperprudente sospechaba de una trampa y no me dejaba pasar! ¡Ahora hemos perdido el rastro de la hechicera archdeva."Don't blame him too much."
